dedupe_keys.name: legion pedestrian simulation and crowd modelling bentley systems

description: LEGION is Bentley Systems' pedestrian simulation and crowd modelling software for testing designs, improving safety and optimising operations before they are built or changed. Users import architectural CAD drawings to define spaces, build pedestrian models from design, demand and operational data, simulate movement scenarios, test what-if cases with automated routing, and analyse and visualise results to communicate performance. Bentley lists railway stations, sports stadiums, airports, office complexes, theatres, piazzas and transport hubs as typical settings. Coverage: generic. Access: purchase online; a 12-month Virtuoso subscription was listed from US$16,330 with one licence and two keys for training or services, and enterprise options on request. Licence: commercial. Caveats: model internals are proprietary, and the product page read here was retrieved through a summarising fetch tool. Simulation uses: station, stadium and public space crowd capacity, congestion and evacuation studies. Related records: MassMotion, Pathfinder and Vadere.
